PixelOS-GM QPR2
Release: 07/07/2025

▪️Download | Mirror

Changelog:
- Reduce zram size to 70% (80% overloaded CPU, hurt memory mgmt)
- Update carrier configs from vauxite
- Disable UFFD GC via OVERRIDE_ENABLE_UFFD_GC
- Update power profiles from hyperos V816.0.11.0
- Update blobs from LA.UM.9.15.2.r1-10600-KAMORTA.QSSI14 & LA.QSSI.15.0.r1-14500
- Remove software c2 codec overrides and restore omx avc
- Fix mixer_paths config loading
- Update VRR brightness restrictions
- kgsl: Refactor bus hints/mod, increase HFI timeout, use kthread for events
- Switch to more efficient DVFS headroom
- spes_defconfog: Use lz4 zram backend( zstd compresses better but decompresses ~3x slower;)
- lz4/crypto/incfs: Use ARM64 v8 ASM for faster lz4 decompression
- lz4armv8: Update asm from Huawei kernel drop
- lz4: Import arm64 v8 ASM accel, v1.10.0 from upstream
- spes_defconfig: Drop CONFIG_CPU_BOOST

Notes:
• Kernel KSU + Manager
• Help maintainer here
• Read Play Integrity

📸 HyperOS 4 Camera - A17
Version: 6.7 Modified by Lazybones 
Device: Redmi Note 11 HyperOS Only
OS: Tested on HOS2/3 only A15 and above, should work on below HOS1/2 A13,A14 as well

Notes:  
✅ What works
•  All mods supported 
 .   Macro and Portrait can't work together by default either portrait or either macro works. Macro uses wrong lens. To fix macro, enable  "turn on dual camera" while to fix portrait disable the same option in experimental settings. One you have used macro camera disable "turn on dual camera" option again otherwise portrait mode won't work. Basically whenever you need to use macro, enable "Turn on Dual Camera Option" in experimental settings, after using it disable that option
. Disable Signature Verification before installing 

. Download: Read Notes above first then download here
